name: The Perfect Stout
objectiveText: Bring 6 Shimmerweeds to Rejold Barleybrew in the Brewnall Village. Shimmerweed  ( 6 )

comments.body:
The path that leads up to the tribe of Seers is at [b]37,42[/b], directly east of the lake beside a small cave.
Hope this helps

I think this one is too hard for a hunter on his own. When you shoot the first target you get chased by two or three [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/search?q=Frostmane%20Troll]Frostmane Troll[/url]s who shoot at you with magic and try to chop you up. The path approaching the camp is narrow, so there is no room to move about for a hunter, nor an opportunity to attack from a different angle.

I spent hours looking for these trolls (I even explored in the far east of Dun Murogh, for the stupid sap I am. It says "high up in the hills to the east" after all :-P). Then the tips here brought me closer, but still no luck. It turns out the path leading up to the troll camp is directly to the left (=north) of the cave entrance where the bears prowl around. Watch for the torches sticking in the ground. The bear cave is, as mentioned, to the east of the Iceflow lake.

There are actually two camps. The first can be found by following the path straight up. The second is nearby. Take a left turn somewhere at the top of the path and cross the suspension bridge. Turn right to find the camp. To the left is another path leading down. Watch out for those trolls! :-)
rogues can use their pick pocket ability to get Shimmerweed from the seers without getting into a big fight (if you succeed)

You find the camp going from the Iceflow lake up, you pass the cave with the bears and then you turn right. As said, some weed get droped by seers, others you find in baskets. 
the Seers are 8 and 9 lvl

I didn't solo this quest until level 14 because it was scarey.  I came out alive. *nod*  Definitely do this with a group.

For this lvl 8 pallie, it was the first quest that was not a complete cakewalk. Combination of longer aggro range than previous quests plus ranged attack meant you could very easily end up with 3 lightning bolts on you at once, so I gave up on the baskets 'cause of the respawn and took out stragglers.

I've died 5 times.  Everytime I start opening a basket I attract the attention of several seers.  Tried sneaking up on a seer, but when I tried to kill just one, I got ambushed by several.  Might be easier with something other than a rogue.

The trolls and baskets are in Shimmer Ridge, Northwest of Kharanos. Go up the hill, and you'll find a small camp of trolls, and baskets scattered all over.

my hunter just killed the troll mages at the perimeter of the hill and looted the secluded shimmerweed baskets. the trolls DO drop the shimmerweed, so i didn't have to actually invade the camp. did this solo without pet at level 9
go to 37,42 and head up the path. all the co-ordinates at the camp itself dont indicate how to get there, since its up a hill

Level 9 at the camp at 41, 44. Stealth in to the opposite side of the camp and pick them off one-by-one. With Pick Pockets and killing, plus two baskets, I finished this off in under 10 minutes.

Of course, without Stealth, you would have a tougher time of it. Work your way around the south end of the camp and do the same process. Don't bother entering the camp by yourself unless you want a trip through Dun Morogh's White-And-Whiter Land.

Easily soloed at level 8 with a priest, I was in the camp at 41, 44. I only pulled two once and they were pretty easy to kill. The rest I just pulled one by one.

Be careful, because they do run away when they have less than 20% life.
